decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already records the exact Hero V and É accent peak-alignment rule, with no incomplete update or stale attribute requiring correction.
The same-message MODIFY already records that the É accent peak must be exactly level with the Hero V terminal peak.
The source Event changes the alignment between the Hero V and É accent; it does not change the second V requirement.
Hero V and É accent peak alignment does not alter the construction or terminal language required for the internal E and L letterforms.
The relational peak-alignment constraint is already owned by the shared terminal and accent requirements and does not revise the approved Hero V master geometry itself.
The geometric alignment decision does not change the deferred champagne-gold material treatment or its application rules.
The peak-alignment refinement implements the existing visual language but does not modify the broader brand-expression requirement.
Aligning the Hero V and É accent peaks does not change the decision to use a wordmark-led identity without a separate icon or monogram.
